//: Narrow hook config for the Explainify session plugin. SessionStart records an immutable repository baseline (start commit + dirty flag); Stop and SessionEnd record a local pointer (session id + transcript path + final-message hash) under the TARGET repo's <cwd>/.explainify/ — never the transcript content. The hook script itself is plugin-local and resolved from CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, so the plugin works from any repository; CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is never referenced.
